The morning tape itself was uninformative (repeated "little changed" and "supplier builds steady" headlines with no new content), and I note the trusted price of $222.70 is about $2 above the feed's last consolidated prints near $220.5 — a discrepancy I flagged but resolved in favor of the trusted source as instructed.
